remarks: LIVE IN THE CENTER OF IT ALL in this beautifully remodeled one-bedroom, one-bath residence located in the heart of downtown Stanford. Just steps from premier dining, vibrant nightlife, boutique shopping, and everyday conveniences, this home offers an unmatched walkable lifestyle. The building features 24/7 maintenance service and security surveillance, a modern on-site laundry facility, and a reserved parking space for added convenience. Inside, enjoy a thoughtfully updated interior featuring a recently remodeled kitchen with granite countertops and a new refrigerator, refinished hardwood floors throughout, and air conditioning for year-round comfort. Heat, hot water, and gas cooking are included in the rent, offering exceptional value. No pets permitted. Two-month security deposit required. Minimum credit score of 700 required. Available February 15th.
